Venice Film Festival Opens with 'Ink' Premiere and Press Debate

The 2026 Venice Film Festival commenced with the premiere of Danny Boyle's new film, 'Ink,' which focuses on the rise of The Sun tabloid newspaper. The opening ceremony red carpet was attended by notable figures including George Clooney and Maggie Gyllenhaal. The festival's opening day also featured discussions centered on the role and challenges facing the press.
